title: Your monthly plan
topic: Small amounts over a long time

steps.title: How a monthly plan grows
steps.body: A savings plan invests the same amount every month. Over the years, the returns start to earn returns too. This is called [[compound-interest]]. Prices still move, so the value goes down at times. A plan needs money that can wait for many years, which means a long [[time-horizon]].

steps.prompt: Look at the chart. Why does the line get steeper over time?
options: The returns start to earn returns of their own
The monthly amount goes up every year
Prices always rise faster later on
steps.explanation: The amount stays at €100 a month. The line gets steeper because each year's returns stay in the plan and earn more returns. This is [[compound-interest]].

chart.caption: €100 a month, with an assumed return of 5% a year. This is an example, not a forecast.

steps.prompt: True or false: a monthly savings plan always makes a profit.
steps.explanation: False. A plan buys a little every month, but its value still falls when prices fall. It needs a long [[time-horizon]] to recover from these falls.

steps.prompt: Today, {monthlyInvesting} a month goes into your savings plan. See how much the plan could be worth after some years, with an assumed return. Move the sliders to change the years, the amount and the return.

output.label: Value of the plan after these years

goal.hint: Move a slider to see the result change.

steps.note: The amount starts at your real plan. This is an example. Returns are not guaranteed and can be negative for years.

steps.title: Your decision
steps.body: Today, **{monthlyInvesting}** a month goes into your savings plan. You spend about **{monthlySpending}** a month. What share of your income do you want to put aside for the long term? You decide. This app explains how money works. It does not recommend products.
steps.bodyNoData: What share of your income do you want to put aside for the long term? You decide. This app explains how money works. It does not recommend products.

rule.label: Share of your income for the long term

scenes.title: How a plan grows
scenes.desc: A monthly plan grows faster in later years, and its value still goes down at times.
